baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative انظر, the manner-question كيف, and the doubled بعضهم على بعض.
baseline_models.mechanism: Directed sight or insight is applied to a field explicitly partitioned into parts, while the favor root supplies comparative degree. The ayah therefore asks how differential ordering is produced relation by relation, not merely whether differences exist.

activation_trace.role: Directed visual or reflective inspection makes the mode of ordering the object of attention.
Partition into parts supplies the shared field across which the comparison operates.
Comparative degree and elevation supply the ordering relation and its emphatic restatement.

changed_reading.before: Notice that some people have more than others.
changed_reading.after: Inspect the relational process by which one part of a shared field is elevated over another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence وللآخرة أكبر درجات وأكبر تفضيلا.
baseline_models.mechanism: After-firstness opens a second horizon; repeated أكبر enlarges both the graded intervals and the differentiating operation. The step-by-step branch of درج makes the plural an ordered scale rather than an undifferentiated abundance.

activation_trace.role: Later-after-first ordering supplies the second temporal horizon.
Magnitude opposed to smallness enlarges both coordinated comparison terms.
Taking by successive degrees supplies ordered intervals within the larger scale.
Degree and superiority name the scale's differentiating force.

changed_reading.after: The later order magnifies both the graded spacing and the force of differentiation between positions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated favor root distributed across the two occurrences of بعض.
baseline_models.mechanism: The increase-or-remainder branch of فضل combines with partition into parts, while counterpart comparison makes asymmetry measurable. Favor can therefore be modeled as an increment distributed unevenly, alongside its ordinary status sense.

activation_trace.role: Increase and remainder supply a distributable surplus behind comparative favor.
Division into portions supplies the recipients among whom the increment differs.
Counterpart comparison supplies the measuring relation that exposes unequal shares.
Greater magnitude scales up the later surplus and its differentiation.

changed_reading.before: Favor denotes only honor or rank.
changed_reading.after: Favor also admits a material model of increment distributed unevenly among portions, with the later increment and differentiation larger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context pairs divine causative showing with visible signs. That sequence changes the focus imperative from detached observation into reception and examination of disclosed evidence: the differential itself can function as a sign whose كيف must be read.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight is the focus-side act of examining what has been disclosed.
Causative showing supplies a disclosed object for the later command to inspect.
A visible sign makes observed differentiation evidential rather than merely spectacular.

structural_cues: 17:1 places the showing of signs in a purpose clause, while 17:21 opens with an imperative plus كيف.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine showing, visible signs, and the focus command to look; I infer that the differential is staged as a sign whose mechanism matters. A live alternative is that the imperative is only a summons to notice an obvious contrast.

changed_reading.before: Look at an already visible hierarchy.
changed_reading.after: Receive the hierarchy as disclosed evidence and investigate how its differential arrangement signifies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence moves from dominating elevation through defeat to restored position, connected increase, numerical predominance, and another later turn. It recasts present favor as historically reversible precedence rather than a stable verdict, sharpening the contrast with the larger later scale.

activation_trace.role: Comparative elevation is the focus-side relation made temporally unstable by the context.
Dominating ascent supplies an initially high worldly position that the sequence overturns.
Return to a prior position supplies the explicit reversal of precedence.
Connected increase supplies renewed resources that alter the balance.
Competitive numerical predominance supplies a concrete form of regained superiority.
A later-after-first turn prevents the restored ordering from becoming final.
Reciprocal return after departure turns the historical pattern into a repeatable reversal.

structural_cues: 17:4-8 sequences elevation, a first appointment, defeat, restored increase, a later appointment, and conditional return.
The paired groups repeatedly exchange the upper position before 17:21 asks the reader to inspect some-over-others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies domination, reversal, renewed extension, numerical predominance, and recurrence; I infer that worldly preferment is provisional and turnable, while the later comparison carries the larger scale. Alternatively, the historical cycle may exemplify only one collective case rather than govern every worldly differential.

changed_reading.before: Worldly superiority is a settled status that previews final rank.
changed_reading.after: Worldly superiority is a reversible allocation in history, so its current holder does not by that fact possess the larger later position.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counting and detailed separation lead into an individually attached record, its outward spread, self-reckoning, and non-transferable burden. This turns the graded scale into an individualized disclosure mechanism rather than only a public status ladder.

activation_trace.role: Successive degrees supply the ordered intervals to which itemized accounting can be related.
Counting and calculation supply the measuring operation behind differentiated outcomes.
Detailed articulation into parts supplies itemization rather than a single undivided verdict.
Adhesion by an imposed judgment supplies the personal attachment of the record.
An organized written object supplies the durable carrier of the differentiated account.
A writing laid open supplies public disclosure of what the record contains.
The person's own self fixes the unit that reads and reckons the account.
A heavy load that cannot be transferred supplies individualized consequence.

structural_cues: 17:12 moves from counting to exhaustive detailing; 17:13-14 attaches, opens, and commands reading of a personal book.
17:15 immediately denies transfer of one burden to another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, detailing, an attached opened record, self-accounting, and non-transferable loads; I infer a ledger-like arrow from those operations to the focus درجات. The live alternative is that the degrees remain status levels whose exact relation to the record is unstated.

changed_reading.before: Degrees are a public ladder on which groups are simply placed.
changed_reading.after: Degrees are also readable as individually itemized and disclosed differentiation, reckoned to each self without transferring its load.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parallel desire clauses contrast an accelerated order, selectively delivered, with a later order approached by movement directed to its proper object and then acknowledged. This activates the focus degrees as a temporally extended, path-sensitive scale rather than merely more of the same immediate goods.

activation_trace.role: Human and divine willing supply the selection structure governing accelerated provision.
Hastening and bringing forward define the immediate order by accelerated timing.
Deferral to a later time supplies the temporal counter-order to acceleration.
Purposeful movement toward an object supplies a path-sensitive relation to the later outcome.
Acknowledged value supplies recognition of the directed striving.
Successive degrees convert the later contrast into an extended graded progression.
Comparative degree supplies the differentiated result of the two temporal orientations.

structural_cues: 17:18 and 17:19 form parallel clauses around whoever desires, but only the later-oriented clause repeats striving and names its recognition.
17:21 follows the common extension of 17:20 and explicitly enlarges the later degrees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceleration, selective willing, later orientation, purpose-fit striving, and recognition; I infer that timing and directed movement help explain why the later degrees are not merely larger immediate allotments. Alternatively, the paired clauses may contrast destinations without making each degree a direct measure of striving.

changed_reading.before: The afterlife offers a quantitatively larger version of present favor.
changed_reading.after: The later order is differently timed and path-sensitive: accelerated allotment gives way to graded differentiation associated with directed, acknowledged striving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same favor root first appears as sought bounty, and the immediate pre-focus ayah places both preceding groups inside one continuing, unbarred gift. The focus comparison therefore differentiates shares within common receipt, not a simple split between recipients and the denied.

activation_trace.role: Bounty bestowed beyond obligation activates gift as a live dimension of the focus favor root.
Total inclusion gathers both contrasted groups into the field of receipt.
Connected increase supplies the continuing flow extended to both groups.
Giving and handing over identify the common flow as gift.
Absence of barring prevents the common gift from being modeled as exclusive admission.
Partition into portions locates inequality inside the inclusive field.
Uneven increment supplies differentiated shares drawn from the common provision.

structural_cues: 17:20 uses كلا and paired demonstratives to include both groups under one extension, then 17:21 immediately narrows universal receipt into some-over-others.
17:12 uses فضل for bounty sought from the Lord before the focus uses the same root for comparative preferment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sought bounty, total inclusion, continued extension, gift, non-barring, and then partitioned preferment; I infer that hierarchy occurs within a common provision stream and cannot alone certify approval. A live alternative is that universal gift says nothing beyond common creaturely support and leaves the reason for unequal shares unspecified.

changed_reading.before: Some are favored because they receive, while the rest are excluded from gift.
changed_reading.after: Both contrasted groups receive from one unbarred gift; favor names unequal extension among recipients, so present abundance alone is not a verdict of approval.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a kinetic branch beneath conventional degrees through the next ayah's sitting posture. It remains anchored in the focus درج and the immediate contrast with تقعد and مخذولا. Render it only as a spatial analogy of movement versus arrested capacity, not as a replacement translation or a claim that the roots define one another.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: درجات at focus index 9, read against the posture and isolation of 17:22.

activation_trace.role: Walking and proceeding along a path supply a kinetic underside to the graded scale.
Incapacity to rise supplies the immediate opposite of proceeding through degrees.
Blame marks the arrested posture as adverse rather than restful.
Separation from one's supporting group supplies the loss of assistance needed for onward movement.

changed_reading.before: Degrees are only fixed slots in a hierarchy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the greater degrees also image capacity for onward passage, contrasted with the next ayah's blamed, unsupported inability to rise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the folding-and-insertion branch of درج rather than the ordinary rank sense. It remains anchored through the focus root and the nearby written record that is attached and spread open. Render it as a material analogy for latent layers becoming disclosed, never as the lexical meaning of درجات in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The material branch of درج at focus index 9, activated by the attached open record in 17:13.

activation_trace.role: Folding and inserting within a covering supply a latent-layer model for degrees.
Firm attachment makes the layered record particular to its bearer.
The written object supplies the material carrier in which layers can remain latent.
Opening and spreading supply the disclosure action that reverses folding.

changed_reading.before: Degrees are exclusively external ranks visible between people.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, degrees can be latent layers folded into each attached record and then spread open for disclosure.

strongest_changes: Worldly preferment becomes reversible allocation within a common, unbarred gift rather than a stable verdict of approval.
The immediate-versus-later contrast turns the larger degrees into a differently timed, path-sensitive scale rather than merely more present goods.
Counting, detailing, attached books, self-accounting, and non-transferable burdens recast degrees as individualized disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated roots and sequence carry the activation: فضل shifts among gift, surplus, and comparative degree; universal extension to both groups is immediately followed by unequal ordering; and the motion branches of درج remain live against the next ayah's arrested sitting.
remaining_uncertainties: The context links later orientation to fitting striving, but it does not state that every individual degree directly measures effort.
The collective reversals of 17:4-8 may exemplify worldly preferment without defining every instance of it.
The kinetic and folded-record readings are deliberately branch-distant and should remain qualified analogies.
